snippet.title: Exit Control - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wake up at midnight in your office. No one’s coming back for days—can you find the way out before the building keeps you forever?

This is the official trailer for Exit Control, a horror escape game where you explore a deserted two–floor office building, search for keys and clues, and survive the eerie silence.

Play it now on Itch.io with link on our channel!

🔹 Atmospheric first-person horror
🔹 Minimal HUD for full immersion
🔹 Explore, survive, and escape

Can you make it to daylight?
